findings.note: Uncovered-mutant enumeration drift in a declared output. The passage correctly states 現在の未カバーは 4 件（F・O・Q・T） and 20 mutant 中 16 件が被覆済み, but two sentences later the same live text asserts 残る 4 件（F と O）は rollback / Evidence / journal 経路にあり… — a count of four with only two mutants named — and the adjacent sentence 現在残るのは、上記の complete and wrote を complete だけに戻す変更 describes mutant F alone as what remains. When Q (round 26) and T (round 29) joined the uncovered set the numeral was bumped 2 to 4 while the sibling enumeration was left at the F-and-O era. This is the exact heading-versus-enumeration defect the very same passage narrates having fixed on 2026-08-29, recurring in the fix site, and it understates where test evidence stops on a Security-Sensitive high task. Rounds 25, 26 and 29 of this package graded this class Major; the round-30 count verifier scans only the report, so the CHANGELOG sits outside its scope and the class recurred there.

The verification contract comment states: Both remaining uncovered guards sit on the rollback/Evidence/journal path, whose correctness there rests on review rather than on regression tests. The same comment earlier declares every mutant except F, O, Q and T killed, and its own appended Q and T paragraphs describe two further uncovered guards. The word Both dates from the pre-round-26 state when F and O were the only uncovered pair; four uncovered guards now sit on that path. Because this sentence is the contract's own authoritative statement of where its evidence stops, the stale two-guard framing materially understates the review-only surface. Measured ground truth from mutation-proofs.log: control 395/0, twenty mutants, sixteen killed, F/O/Q/T at control tally. Same drift event as the CHANGELOG finding; per this package's own precedent (round 29: three Majors, all count drift, one per site) it is recorded per artifact.

findings.note: Present-tense uncovered-set claims without the same-line historical markers the round-29 remediation itself established: the report asserts the current uncovered total is one, F (two sites, no marker on the claim line) and F and O are the uncovered pair; the mutation log's F note says F and O are the pair that remain, contradicted by the same log's own Q and T UNCOVERED entries below it. Era-inferable from surrounding round narrative, so Minor rather than Major, but the report's own convention says a marker only exempts the number it sits with, and these numbers carry none. That F note has already been through one staleness correction (round 22, an Anthropic Minor) and is stale again.
